sentences.zh: 是的，最初的反应之一就是泽连斯基总统称这是一个软弱的决定。

sentences.en: Well, I look at it differently.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是从不同角度看的。

sentences.en: Zelensky could have settled this war many times.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基原本可以很多次解决这场战争。

sentences.en: Many, many times.
sentences.zh: 很多、很多次。

sentences.en: And you actually then had this new back-and-forth spat between Zelensky and Trump play out over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 然后你实际上看到泽连斯基和特朗普之间在周末上演了一场新的隔空交锋。

sentences.en: I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal, because he could have made many deals that for some reason he'd ever done.
sentences.zh: 我建议他们换个能达成协议的新领导人，因为他本可以达成许多不知为何他从未做到的协议。

sentences.en: And there was shock across Europe also, because really, up until now, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 整个欧洲也感到震惊，因为实际上，直到现在，美国

sentences.en: had really stayed tough in terms of sanctions policy toward Russia and had also continued supporting Ukraine in many ways.
sentences.zh: 在对俄制裁政策上一直表现强硬，并且在许多方面继续支持乌克兰。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Officials in Europe and elsewhere had long feared that Trump might take a softer approach to Russia, might pursue a closer relationship.
sentences.zh: 欧洲及其他地区的官员长期以来一直担心特朗普可能会对俄罗斯采取更温和的态度，可能会追求更紧密的关系。

sentences.en: But that hadn't happened yet.
sentences.zh: 但那还没有发生。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's important to step back and sort of see that despite all the worries of what Trump might do vis-a-vis Ukraine and Russia,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，退一步来看很重要，那就是尽管人们担心特朗普在乌克兰和俄罗斯问题上可能会做什么，

sentences.en: the Trump administration really kept a lot of the Biden-era policies in place,
sentences.zh: 但特朗普政府确实保留了许多拜登时期的政策，

sentences.en: whether it's in terms of providing intelligence support to Ukraine's war effort and keeping the sanctions in place.
sentences.zh: 无论是向乌克兰的战争努力提供情报支持，还是维持制裁。

sentences.en: In fact, expanding the sanctions.
sentences.zh: 事实上，还在扩大制裁。

sentences.en: A year ago, the administration put in place really tough new sanctions against Russia's oil industry.
sentences.zh: 一年前，政府对俄罗斯石油工业实施了极为严厉的新制裁。

sentences.en: And just a few weeks ago, Trump signed a bipartisan bill out of Congress that allowed for new sweeping sanctions against Russia and especially Russian energy.
sentences.zh: 就在几周前，特朗普签署了国会通过的一项两党法案，允许对俄罗斯特别是俄罗斯能源实施全面新制裁。

sentences.en: So this move on Russian diesel, even though the numbers are relatively small,
sentences.zh: 因此，针对俄罗斯柴油的这一举措，尽管数量相对较小，

sentences.en: is still the most concrete sign that this administration in Washington is ready to really substantively change its relationship with Russia and to do so potentially at Ukraine's expense.
sentences.zh: 仍然是华盛顿现政府准备真正实质性改变与俄罗斯关系的最具体信号，而这可能以牺牲乌克兰为代价。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: All right, Anton, obviously, a lot of countries are quite shaken by this news.
sentences.zh: 好的，安东，显然许多国家对这个消息感到相当震惊。

sentences.en: What is the Trump administration's defense of this U-turn in American policy?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府对美国政策的这一大转弯是如何辩解的？

sentences.en: Well, a few things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，主要有这么几点。

sentences.en: I mean, on buying diesel, I think what you'll hear is this is America firSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在购买柴油方面，我想你会听到这是“美国优先”。

sentences.en: This is taking care of American consumers, American farmers at a time when they're struggling.
sentences.zh: 这是在照顾处于困境中的美国消费者和美国农民。

sentences.en: They will also say that Europe has continued to buy Russian energy.
sentences.zh: 他们还会说，欧洲一直在继续购买俄罗斯能源。

sentences.en: And to some extent, that's true.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这确实是真的。

sentences.en: Europe is still buying Russian liquefied natural gas.
sentences.zh: 欧洲仍在购买俄罗斯的液化天然气。

sentences.en: Landlocked countries, in particular Slovakia and Hungary, are still buying Russian oil.
sentences.zh: 内陆国家，特别是斯洛伐克和匈牙利，仍在购买俄罗斯石油。

sentences.en: Now, the EU has drastically reduced its reliance on Russian energy and is actually planning to completely end Russian gas imports by next year.
sentences.zh: 目前，欧盟已大幅减少对俄罗斯能源的依赖，并实际上计划在明年完全停止进口俄罗斯天然气。

sentences.en: So here we're definitely moving in opposite directions.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，我们显然在朝着相反的方向前进。

sentences.en: I think folks in the administration, they'd also say that Trump is still set on somehow ending the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我想政府内部的人也会说，特朗普仍然决心以某种方式结束乌克兰战争。

sentences.en: Of course, we should also say this is something that is deeply uncomfortable, not just for American allies in Europe, not just for even Democrats, but also many Republicans.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们还应该指出，这不仅让欧洲的美国盟友感到极度不安，不仅让民主党人感到不安，也让许多共和党人感到不安。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So if the America first argument for this policy is that buying Russian diesel will lower prices at the pump for Americans, is that true?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果这项政策的“美国优先”论点是购买俄罗斯柴油会降低美国人的加油站油价，这属实吗？

sentences.en: Like brass tacks, how much will this actually lower gas prices in the United States?
sentences.zh: 说实话，这到底能在多大程度上降低美国的油价？

sentences.en: So minimally.
sentences.zh: 微乎其微。

sentences.en: I mean, the initial number we're talking about is an extra 300,000 tons of Russian diesel onto the global market.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们最初讨论的数字是向全球市场额外投放30万吨俄罗斯柴油。

sentences.en: That's less than one day of consumption in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这还不到美国一天的消费量。

sentences.en: Less than one day?
sentences.zh: 连一天都不到？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I did check the AAA gas prices numbers.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实查了美国汽车协会（AAA）的油价数据。

sentences.en: So as of Tuesday, diesel is $6.28 a gallon compared to $6.32 a gallon a week ago.
sentences.zh: 因此，截至周二，柴油价格为每加仑6.28美元，而一周前为每加仑6.32美元。

sentences.en: So the price has gone down, but not by much.
sentences.zh: 所以价格确实下降了，但幅度不大。

sentences.en: And the amount that would be coming in really wouldn't make a dent in the overall demand that there is, right?
sentences.zh: 而且即将流入的数量确实无法对整体需求产生什么影响，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But at least it's an effort.
sentences.zh: 但至少这是一种努力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think this has a lot of symbolism, both at home and abroad.
sentences.zh: 我认为这具有很强的象征意义，无论在国内外都是如此。

sentences.en: At home, it's a thing that can be messaged to voters of this administration is taking drastic steps to try to bring the price of diesel under control.
sentences.zh: 在国内，它可以向选民传递这样一个信息：本届政府正在采取极端的步骤，试图将柴油价格控制住。

sentences.en: It is a message to Russia of this administration is willing to do stuff that is going to be criticized in many quarters for being too friendly to Russia.
sentences.zh: 这是向俄罗斯发出的一个信号：本届政府愿意做那些在许多方面会因“对俄过于友好”而受到批评的事情。

sentences.en: And frankly,
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，

sentences.en: it's yet another message both to Ukraine and to Europe that President Trump and his top officials are really willing to pursue their own path on matters of global security.
sentences.zh: 这也是向乌克兰和欧洲发出的又一个信号，表明特朗普总统和他的高级官员在全方位安全事务上确实愿意走自己的路。

sentences.en: But just thinking about Europe's and Ukraine's concern here, can I just ask, how much will this policy actually help Russia in funding its war in Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 但一想到欧洲和乌克兰的担忧，我只想问，这项政策实际上会对俄罗斯资助其在乌克兰的战争起到多大帮助？

sentences.en: Because if this is just symbolic and not all that meaningful for U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为如果这只是象征性的，对美国消费者来说意义不大，

sentences.en: consumers, I'm wondering how much of an impact it'll have in Russia.
sentences.zh: 我在想它会对俄罗斯产生多大的影响。

sentences.en: Well, at the end of the day, oil and gas exports are at the core of what drives the Russian economy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说到底，石油和天然气出口是驱动俄罗斯经济的核心。

sentences.en: So any chink in the West's sanctions wall against Russian energy is important for Putin.
sentences.zh: 因此，西方针对俄罗斯能源的制裁墙上的任何裂缝对普京来说都很重要。

sentences.en: So I think what you'll see is Putin very much pocketing the win here and not, as of yet, changing the way he's approaching the war.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你会看到普京会把这场胜利稳稳揣进口袋，目前还不会改变他对待战争的方式。

sentences.en: After Trump made this announcement on Friday,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普周五宣布这一消息之后，

sentences.en: the Kremlin has continued to say that they're not ready to negotiate with Ukraine and they have continued to hit Ukrainian infrastructure, causing civilians to die.
sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫继续表示他们尚未准备好与乌克兰进行谈判，并继续打击乌克兰基础设施，导致平民伤亡。

sentences.en: They have not changed their approach to this war.
sentences.zh: 他们没有改变对待这场战争的方式。

sentences.en: Do you get the impression that that pisses Trump off?
sentences.zh: 你有没有觉得这让特朗普很恼火？

sentences.en: Like, wasn't part of the premise of all of this deal making, deal dangling to eventually end the war?
sentences.zh: 比如，所有这些交易筹码、悬而未决的交易，其前提不就是为了最终结束战争吗？

sentences.en: And yet, here you have Russia taking the symbolic win and keeping up the strikes.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这里，俄罗斯却获得了象征性的胜利，并继续发动袭击。

sentences.en: No, I don't have any indication that Trump has gotten more upset at Putin over this.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有任何迹象表明特朗普因此对普京更加生气。

sentences.en: What all our reporting points to is that Trump right now is fixated on Zelensky and is angry at Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的报道都表明，特朗普现在满脑子都是泽连斯基，并且对泽连斯基感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Clearly, in part because of the high diesel prices, high gas prices here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 显然，部分原因是因为美国国内高昂的柴油价格、高昂的油价，

sentences.en: and the approaching midterMs.
sentences.zh: 以及即将到来的中期选举。

sentences.en: And that, of course, has been a theme throughout for most of the last two years.
sentences.zh: 当然，在过去两年多的时间里，这一直是一个贯穿始终的主题。

sentences.en: Trump really giving Putin the benefit of the doubt, even as this war escalates, and putting the onus on compromise and settlement onto Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 即使这场战争不断升级，特朗普也确实给予普京信任，并将妥协和解决问题的责任推给泽连斯基。

sentences.en: And the question, of course, is, does this affect other kinds of ongoing U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，问题是，这会影响美国对乌克兰其他形式的持续支持吗？

sentences.en: support for Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 当然，问题是，这会影响美国对乌克兰其他形式的持续支持吗？

sentences.en: President Trump said on Tuesday that U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统周二表示，美国对乌克兰的

sentences.en: intelligence support for Ukraine is continuing.
sentences.zh: 情报支持仍在继续。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians need that for both targeting and seeing what Russia is firing at them.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人需要这些情报来进行目标定位，并观察俄罗斯在向他们发射什么。

sentences.en: But the Ukrainians are definitely worried that this is something that Trump could put into play.
sentences.zh: 但乌克兰人绝对担心这是特朗普可能会付诸实施的事情。

sentences.en: Anton, am I right that we should see what's happening now as a shift in the Trump administration's strategy in terms of pressuring Russia?
sentences.zh: 安东，我是不是可以这样理解：我们应该将目前发生的事情视为特朗普政府在施压俄罗斯方面的策略转变？

sentences.en: At the outset, you said they were holding out the promise of these business deals as an incentive to get Russia to end the war.
sentences.zh: 一开始你说他们以这些商业交易作为诱饵，以此来激励俄罗斯结束战争。

sentences.en: And now, instead of a reward, it sounds like they're using these deals as something like a down payment.
sentences.zh: 而现在，听起来他们不再把这些交易作为奖励，而是把它当成了某种首付款。

sentences.en: Like, they're banking on the idea that giving Russia a taste of what a close relationship feels like can get Putin to agree to stop fighting.
sentences.zh: 就像他们押注于这样一种理念：让俄罗斯尝到紧密关系的滋味就能促使普京同意停止战斗。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，绝对如此。

sentences.en: I think one of the shocking things to people about this diesel agreement has been that, as far as we know,
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对这项柴油协议感到震惊的事情之一是，据我们所知，

sentences.en: there is no concession that the Russians made in return for the sanctions being lifted.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯并没有为解除制裁做出任何让步。

sentences.en: So, yeah, and our reporting does indicate that there are other deals that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们的报道确实表明，美国和俄罗斯还在讨论其他交易，他们甚至可能在战争尚未结束之前就将其付诸实施。

sentences.en: and Russia are talking about that they might even do without the war coming to an end firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们的报道确实表明，美国和俄罗斯还在讨论其他交易，他们甚至可能在战争尚未结束之前就将其付诸实施。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: Give me an example of that.
sentences.zh: 给我举个例子。

sentences.en: Well, look, we know a lot of different deals have been discussed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，我们知道有很多不同的交易一直在被讨论。

sentences.en: I mean, the future that is being imagined here is one where there are no more sanctions and tons of deals, tons of money flowing between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里所设想的未来是一个没有更多制裁、海量交易、巨额资金在美国和俄罗斯之间流动的未来。

sentences.en: and Russia.
sentences.zh: 和俄罗斯。

sentences.en: But there is one specific deal that we've been reporting on over the last few weeks that is quite far along.
sentences.zh: 但我们过去几周一直在报道的一项具体交易进展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: And that's the purchase of the international assets of a big Russian oil company called Luke Oil.
sentences.zh: 这就是收购一家名为卢克石油的大型俄罗斯石油公司的国际资产。

sentences.en: Basically, what that would be would be for a group of investors to come in and buy those billions of dollars in assets of this energy company,
sentences.zh: 基本上，这将是一群投资者进来收购这家能源公司的数十亿美元资产，

sentences.en: be it refineries, oil fields, even gas stations in New Jersey, in what would be a really lucrative transaction because Luke Oil is under U.S.
sentences.zh: 无论是炼油厂、油田，甚至是新泽西州的加油站，这将是一笔非常赚钱的交易，因为卢克石油正受到美国的制裁。

sentences.en: sanctions.
sentences.zh: 制裁。

sentences.en: And as soon as Luke Oil agrees to sell those assets and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一旦卢克石油同意出售这些资产并且美国批准了这笔交易，这些资产的价值就会飙升。

sentences.en: approves the sale, the value of those assets would go way up.
sentences.zh: 然后更重要的是，如果你看看现在接近签署这项交易的这些投资者都是谁。

sentences.en: And then even more significant is if you look at who these investors are that are now close to signing this deal.
sentences.zh: 然后更重要的是，如果你看看现在接近签署这项交易的这些投资者都是谁。

sentences.en: Who are they?
sentences.zh: 他们是谁？

sentences.en: So it's an investor group led by Todd Boley, the American billionaire who has made donations to Trump's political causes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由美国亿万富翁托德·伯利领导的投资者集团，他曾向特朗普的政治事业捐款。

sentences.en: And, of course, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，美国政府也将参股。

sentences.en: government would take a stake.
sentences.zh: 政府也将参股。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: But so would several investors from the Middle East who have business ties to Witkoff and Kushner.
sentences.zh: 但几位与维特科夫和库什纳有业务联系的中东投资者也将参股。

sentences.en: For example, two Syrian-Qatari billionaire brothers who are also business partners with Jared Kushner and his wife, Ivanka Trump, the president's daughter, on a resort in Albania.
sentences.zh: 例如，两名叙利亚-卡塔尔亿万富翁兄弟，他们也是贾里德·库什纳及其妻子、总统女儿伊万卡·特朗普在阿尔巴尼亚一处度假村项目上的商业伙伴。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You're saying this particular deal, it benefits the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你是说这笔特定的交易，它不仅让美国政府受益，也让参与这笔交易谈判的人受益，也就是那些接近特朗普家族的人。

sentences.en: government, but also the people who are negotiating the deal itself, people close to the Trump family.
sentences.zh: 谈判的人，也就是那些接近特朗普家族的人。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, it benefits the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，它让美国政府受益。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: There's an argument to be made that it also benefits American foreign policy because it would give the U.S.
sentences.zh: 有一种观点认为，它也对美国的外部政策有利，因为它将使美国在这些具有重大战略意义的资产中占有一席之地，比如欧洲这些非常大的炼油厂。

sentences.en: a stake in these really strategically significant assets like, again, these very large refineries in Europe.
sentences.zh: 中占有一席之地，比如欧洲这些非常大的炼油厂。

sentences.en: What we've been hearing from the administration is Witkoff and Kushner have been doing this only in the service of American interests,
sentences.zh: 我们从政府听到的消息是，维特科夫和库什纳这样做完全是为了服务于美国利益，

sentences.en: and there is no indication that Witkoff or Kushner would profit directly.
sentences.zh: 没有迹象表明维特科夫或库什纳会直接从中获利。

sentences.en: But, of course, there are many potential investors out there,
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，外面有很多潜在的投资者，

sentences.en: and it is significant that the investors getting a piece of this potentially very lucrative deal are ones with business ties to the two main American negotiators.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，分得这笔潜在利润丰厚交易一杯羹的投资者，是那些与这两位主要美国谈判代表有商业联系的人。

sentences.en: Anton, just stepping back,
sentences.zh: 安东，退一步讲，

sentences.en: is there any indication that this strategy of pursuing these deals has begun to encourage Russia or Putin himself to come to the table to try to actually end this war?
sentences.zh: 是否有任何迹象表明，奉行这些交易的策略已经开始鼓励俄罗斯或普京本人坐到谈判桌前，尝试真正结束这场战争？

sentences.en: Like, do we know if this may be working at all?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们知道这是否起到了哪怕一点点作用吗？

sentences.en: I mean, as you know, before coming to Washington, I covered Russia and I covered Putin,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如你所知，在来华盛顿之前，我报道过俄罗斯，也报道过普京，

sentences.en: and I know that many American administrations have really struggled with how best to engage Putin.
sentences.zh: 我知道许多美国政府一直在如何最好地与普京接触这个问题上苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: Obviously, the prior administration was not able to head off Putin's invasion of Ukraine or to end it,
sentences.zh: 显然，前任政府没能阻止普京对乌克兰的入侵，也没能结束它，

sentences.en: and the strategy was really to take a very hard line against Russia and try to diplomatically isolate Russia.
sentences.zh: 当时的策略实际上是对俄罗斯采取非常强硬的路线，并试图在外交上孤立俄罗斯。

sentences.en: This administration has been bringing Russia back into the fold, right?
sentences.zh: 现政府一直在把俄罗斯重新拉回阵营，对吧？

sentences.en: We have Trump speaking regularly to Putin on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们看到特朗普定期与普京通电话。

sentences.en: We have Witkoff and Kushner traveling regularly to Russia to meet with Putin.
sentences.zh: 我们看到维特科夫和库什纳定期前往俄罗斯与普京会面。

sentences.en: We saw the Russian finance minister come to the G20 recently in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 我们看到俄罗斯财政部长最近出席了在北卡罗来纳州举行的G20会议。

sentences.en: We might have Putin coming to the big G20 summit in Miami in December.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可能会看到普京出席12月在迈阿密举行的G20大型峰会。

sentences.en: They are really engaging him.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在积极接触他。

sentences.en: And we know, in a way, that is something that Russia really wants.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道，在某种程度上，这正是俄罗斯真正想要的。

sentences.en: Putin really wants to be seen as an equal to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 普京非常希望被视为与美国平起平坐。

sentences.en: He wants to be talking to the American president.
sentences.zh: 他希望与美国总统对话。

sentences.en: But we've got to acknowledge that this new approach of engagement, it's been since Trump returned to office early last year, and it still hasn't worked.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须承认，这种接触的新方法自去年初特朗普重返白宫以来一直在进行，但它仍然没有奏效。

sentences.en: The war has only escalated.
sentences.zh: 战争不仅没有停止，反而升级了。

sentences.en: By many accounts, it's actually only gotten more dangerous as Putin's bombardments and Russia's hybrid war with Europe intensifies.
sentences.zh: 据多方报道，随着普京的轰炸以及俄罗斯与欧洲混合战争的加剧，情况实际上变得更加危险了。

sentences.en: So the big question to me going forward is, what about all the other stuff that Putin wants and is going to need to be negotiated?
sentences.zh: 因此，对我而言，未来最大的问题是，普京想要的所有其他东西以及需要通过谈判解决的问题该怎么办？

sentences.en: As discussed, Putin cares about the geopolitics of Russia's relationship with NATO,
sentences.zh: 如前所述，普京关心的是俄罗斯与北约关系的地缘政治，

sentences.en: the problems of territory and how to keep Ukraine sovereign and make sure Russia is not able to invade again.
sentences.zh: 领土问题，以及如何保持乌克兰的主权并确保俄罗斯无法再次入侵。

sentences.en: And so it's those really complicated questions where clearly there's still a lot of work to be done.
sentences.zh: 因此，正是这些极其复杂的问题，显然还有大量的工作要做。

sentences.en: I guess my question is, if this ultimately doesn't work, if Putin continues to escalate,
sentences.zh: 我想我的问题是，如果这最终不管用，如果普京继续升级局势，

sentences.en: do you think Trump eventually decides to pull back on this strategy of getting closer to Russia?
sentences.zh: 你认为特朗普最终会决定收回这种拉近与俄罗斯关系的策略吗？

sentences.en: Well, honestly, the indication for now is more the opposite, that Trump could end up pulling back from Ukraine and engaging with Russia despite the war continuing.
sentences.zh: 老实说，目前的迹象更多是相反的，即尽管战争仍在继续，特朗普最终可能会从乌克兰撤退并与俄罗斯进行接触。

sentences.en: You know, that is something that Putin has been trying to achieve ever since Trump returned to office.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是普京自特朗普重返白宫以来一直试图实现的目标。

sentences.en: Putin has been trying to say to Trump, look at all these business deals we could do if we just forget about the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 普京一直试图对特朗普说：只要我们忘掉乌克兰战争，看看我们能做多少生意。

sentences.en: Like, don't condition your engagement on the war.
sentences.zh: 就像是，不要把你的接触建立在战争是否停止的前提上。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Let's treat these two things as separate.
sentences.zh: 让我们把这两件事分开对待。

sentences.en: That has been a policy goal of the Kremlin for the last year and a half and more.
sentences.zh: 这在过去一年半甚至更长的时间里一直是克里姆林宫的政策目标。

sentences.en: So, I mean, what is the impact of that in the long term in terms of our policy in Russia?
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，从我们的俄罗斯政策来看，这在长期会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Are we looking at a world at some point in the future in which economic pressure on Russia, one of our biggest adversaries, is no longer a point of leverage,
sentences.zh: 我们是否在展望未来的某个世界：对俄罗斯（我们最大的对手之一）的经济施压不再是一个筹码，

sentences.en: either as a carrot or a stick?
sentences.zh: 无论是胡萝卜还是大棒？

sentences.en: No, I mean, there are still a ton of sanctions on Russia.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，对俄罗斯的制裁仍然堆积如山。

sentences.en: And my sense is the administration does still see those sanctions as leverage, but potentially in a more incremental way than immediately getting Russia to end the war.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，政府仍然将这些制裁视为筹码，但可能比立即迫使俄罗斯结束战争更具渐进性。

sentences.en: I think after the midterms and certainly after the next presidential election, you can very much imagine U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为在中期选举之后，当然还有在下一次总统大选之后，你可以完全想象美国的

sentences.en: policy shifting again into a more traditional mode.
sentences.zh: 政策再次转向更传统的模式。

sentences.en: It'll be really important to see what happens in Europe, because in Europe right now, you have a far right and far left movement, Germany, France, U.K.,
sentences.zh: 看看欧洲会发生什么将非常重要，因为在欧洲现在，极右翼和极左翼运动（德国、法国、英国）

sentences.en: promoting a more friendly relationship to Russia.
sentences.zh: 正在推动与俄罗斯建立更友好的关系。

sentences.en: For example, especially in Germany, there's a lot of talk on the far right about why aren't we importing Russian gas again?
sentences.zh: 例如，特别是在德国，极右翼有很多关于“我们为什么不重新进口俄罗斯天然气”的讨论。

sentences.en: And so that's going to be a really key thing to watch.
sentences.zh: 所以这将是一个非常关键的观察点。

sentences.en: Does Europe still keep its hard line or do upcoming elections there change how France and Germany and others are dealing with Russia?
sentences.zh: 欧洲是会继续坚持其强硬路线，还是那里的即将到来的选举会改变法国、德国和其他国家与俄罗斯打交道的方式？

sentences.en: And finally, you know, I've heard a lot of speculation from analysts following the war that at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 最后，你知道，我听到关注这场战争的分析人士有很多猜测，说归根结底，

sentences.en: it's going to be some kind of negotiation directly between Russia and Ukraine that ends this war.
sentences.zh: 最终结束这场战争的将是俄罗斯和乌克兰之间某种形式的直接谈判。

sentences.en: Because we've clearly seen that there are limits to U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为我们已经清楚地看到，美国对俄罗斯和乌克兰的

sentences.en: leverage both on Russia and on Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 影响力都是有限的。

sentences.en: So that kind of brings us back, I think, to the main victims here.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得这把我们带回了这里的核心受害者问题。

sentences.en: The awful thing about all this is that all these business negotiations and this brinksmanship on sanctions and deals and what's going to happen to the diesel supply,
sentences.zh: 这一切最可怕的地方在于，所有这些商业谈判、关于制裁和交易的边缘政策，以及柴油供应将面临的局面，

sentences.en: that is all playing out as this war gets worse and worse on the ground in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这一切都在乌克兰地面战争愈演愈烈的同时上演着。

sentences.en: As the winter approaches, at a time when Ukraine is extremely low on missile defenses, Russia is going to be able to make this winter truly awful.
sentences.zh: 随着冬天临近，在乌克兰防空导弹极其匮乏之际，俄罗斯将能够让这个冬天变得真正糟糕。

sentences.en: And there, for the moment, we still see no end in sight.
sentences.zh: 而目前看来，我们依然看不到这场冲突的尽头。

sentences.en: Well, Anton, thanks for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 好的，安东，感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 金伯利·吉尔福伊尔于周二辞去了美国驻希腊大使职务，

sentences.en: ambassador to Greece on Tuesday after the White House asked her to step down.
sentences.zh: 此前白宫要求她卸任。

sentences.en: Guilfoyle had been the subject of a string of damaging reports that first appeared in The Wall Street Journal about her potential conflicts of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 吉尔福伊尔此前曾被《华尔街日报》等媒体曝光了一系列关于她潜在利益冲突的负面报道。

sentences.en: For example, a Republican donor said that Guilfoyle had asked him to wire her $100,000 to pay off her credit card just before her Senate confirmation hearing last year,
sentences.zh: 例如，一名共和党捐赠者表示，就在去年参议院听证会召开前夕，吉尔福伊尔曾要求他电汇10万美元来帮她偿还信用卡债务，

sentences.en: promising to serve as the donor's, quote, ride or die in the Trump world if he sent the money.
sentences.zh: 并承诺如果他打钱，就会在特朗普阵营中做他的所谓“生死之交”。

sentences.en: In a social media post, Guilfoyle said she planned to, quote, vigorously defend her name, reputation, and integrity.
sentences.zh: 吉尔福伊尔在社交媒体发文中表示，她计划所谓“极力捍卫自己的名誉、声誉和正直”。

sentences.en: And Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer on Tuesday, and a lower lobe of his right lung was removed during surgery.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥十四世于周二被诊断出患有肺癌，并在手术中切除了右肺下叶。

sentences.en: The Vatican said in a statement that the operation was successful and there were no complications, but didn't specify whether the Pope would undergo further treatment.
sentences.zh: 梵蒂冈在一份声明中表示手术成功且没有出现并发症，但未明确教皇是否会接受进一步治疗。

sentences.en: Finally, Cornell University announced that it was banning parties at fraternity houses for the rest of the academic year
sentences.zh: 最后，康奈尔大学宣布在接下来的学年里禁止兄弟会住所举办派对，

sentences.en: in response to a student's allegation of gang rape in October 2024.
sentences.zh: 以回应一名学生对2024年10月轮奸案的指控。

sentences.en: The university also said that it would add experienced sexual assault investigators to work with its police force.
sentences.zh: 该大学还表示，将增派经验丰富的性侵调查人员与警方合作。

sentences.en: Cornell's president told The Times that the ban would allow for a thorough review of frat life on campus to determine whether it could safely resume.
sentences.zh: 康奈尔大学校长对《泰晤士报》表示，这项禁令将有助于对校园兄弟会生活进行全面审查，以确定其是否能够安全恢复。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Claire Tennesketter, Adrienne Hurst, and Eric Krupke.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·特内斯凯特、阿德里安娜·赫斯特和埃里克·克鲁普克制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett and Lizzo Baylin.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·考维特和利佐·贝林编辑。

sentences.en: It contains music by Marion Lozano and Elisheva Etoop, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 节目包含马里恩·洛扎诺和埃利舍瓦·埃托普的音乐，由阿莉莎·莫克斯利进行音频工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由旺德利创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittrowak.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗瓦克。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个被严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又惊心动魄的权力争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我，萨拉·科尼格，将为你讲述那些试图维持影响力却最终失去控制的人们的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Let's see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。
